description: This file contains signal handling setup, including defining how signals are managed during program initialization and cleanup. It sets up signal handlers to ignore or reset signals like SIGPIPE, SIGQUIT, SIGTERM, SIGINT, and SIGABRT, and includes functions that run at program start and exit.

methods.name: void resetSignals(void)
methods.description: Sets up default signal handlers, ignoring SIGPIPE and resetting others like SIGQUIT, SIGTERM, SIGINT, and SIGABRT to their default behavior.

methods.name: void mainInit(void)
methods.description: Initializes the environment just before main() runs; sets up signal handling, initializes logging, and registers cleanup functions.

methods.name: void mainCleanup(void)
methods.description: Cleans up resources just after main() ends, currently a no-op.
